title: Protecting patients beyond the chair
html: As I begin my role as President of the American Dental Association (ADA) this month, I am reminded of what drew me to become a dentist: the blending of art and science and the role oral health plays in overall health. My desire to understand the disease process and how to manage it led to a degree in microbiology. Understanding the immune system, infection, and antibiotics spurred a lifelong passion related to antibiotic stewardship.
